booking.heading: Book Us for a Gig
booking.description: Have us perform at your next event! We love collaborating with other groups and performing for the community.
booking.details: For booking inquiries, email vocalu@umn.edu with the date, location, and a little about your event.

faqs.question: What is Vocal U?
faqs.answer: Vocal U is a gender-inclusive a cappella group at the University of Minnesota, established in 2011. We come from all different majors and backgrounds, but we're all a part of VU because we love music and the arts.

faqs.question: What do you sing?
faqs.answer: Our repertoire includes Back to Black, Ribs, Wings, and a Phineas & Ferb medley. Each semester, we carry over half of our existing songs and choose new ones by a vote.

faqs.question: Where can I see you perform?
faqs.answer: We perform at U of M events, charity events, and around the Twin Cities. Our events page has upcoming performances and past shows. You can also watch our performances on YouTube.

faqs.question: Can I book Vocal U for an event?
faqs.answer: Yes! We love collaborating with other groups and performing for the community. Email vocalu@umn.edu with the date, location, and a little about your event to ask about booking us.

faqs.question: How do I audition?
faqs.answer: Check our audition page for dates and updates. We also post audition announcements on Instagram at @vocal_u. If you have a question about auditions, email us at vocalu@umn.edu.
